evals.name: consolidate
evals.prompt:
Revise only the supplied README excerpt for a retry fix. Add the relevant documentation and preserve useful guidance. Return the revised excerpt, followed by a brief reason for the change. The fix restores the already documented three attempts. No behavior, command, or configuration changed.
README excerpt:
## Sending requests
Requests make at most three attempts. Set RETRY_LIMIT to change this limit. See [request configuration](docs/configuration.md#requests) for retry settings.
See [retry limit](docs/configuration.md#requests) for more information about the number of attempts.
We previously used a loop inside sendRequest, but RetryController now handles retries.
evals.expected_output: Consolidate the pointers, preserve the attempt limit and RETRY_LIMIT guidance, and omit fix history and private implementation details.

evals.name: placement
evals.prompt: A monorepo has README.md for service operators, CONTRIBUTING.md for contributors, docs/configuration.md for operator settings, and packages/client/README.md for SDK consumers. A new SDK option requestTimeoutMs defaults to 30000 and throws TimeoutError on expiry. An internal helper builds an AbortController. Recommend the smallest documentation change. Include the exact proposed prose and placement, and explain whether to add YAML audience metadata and duplicate the option's full reference in the root README. There is no existing metadata convention or metadata consumer. The reason for 30000 is unknown.
evals.expected_output: Document the public option in the client README only, preserving units, default, and error type without inventing rationale or metadata requirements.

evals.name: comment
evals.prompt:
Revise this JSDoc after a refactor that changes no public behavior. Return the JSDoc and any additional documentation changes you recommend. The method still raises TimeoutError at the caller-provided timeout; a private helper now uses AbortController. No rationale for the timeout policy is available.
/** Sends a request. Rejects with TimeoutError when timeoutMs elapses. */
evals.expected_output: Preserve the public timeout contract; no extra implementation documentation or history is required.

evals.name: red-approval
evals.prompt: You are adding a 100-word rollback procedure to docs/operations.md. The size checker reports {"state":"red","words":3110}. The release is in ten minutes, the reviewer wants no new files, and the other sections are already polished. No split has been approved. State your next actions and the condition for marking this work complete. Do not actually edit files.
evals.expected_output: Stop the affected documentation work, report the measured count, and propose a concrete split with paths, scope, and navigation for user approval. Do not create files or treat a size exception as completion. Completion requires approved restructuring, checks on every created or modified document, and no red results. Do not check unchanged documents.

evals.name: yellow-growth
evals.prompt: docs/setup.md has been measured at 2850 words with state yellow. You need to add 250 words. Its introduction addresses new contributors, but the proposed section is an operator disaster-recovery procedure. Recommend the next actions, including size verification and whether you will create another document without asking. Do not actually edit files.
evals.expected_output: Review the scope mismatch and expected growth into red. Find existing operator guidance or propose a new home for approval without creating it. Require the bundled checker only after revisions to created or modified documentation, not before editing or on unchanged documents. Do not finish in red. A concrete scope mismatch, rather than yellow alone, justifies the proposal.

evals.name: opening-scope
evals.prompt: Write only the text between the H1 and first H2 of docs/client-configuration.md. It is for SDK consumers who need to configure per-request timeouts and interpret TimeoutError. It is not a service-operator guide, not a contributor setup guide, and does not explain internal cancellation helpers. Keep it short. Then explain what signals would make a future addition or a rewrite inappropriate for this document.
evals.expected_output: Provide an unheaded opening scope statement with purpose, audience, coverage, and meaningful exclusions. Recognize audience and task mismatches independently of word count. Recommend broader restructuring when the document loses a coherent scope, with user approval before moving sections or creating documents.

evals.name: quiet-yellow
evals.prompt: The only documentation change in this task is a verified 15-word clarification in docs/timeouts.md. The bundled checker reports 2800 words, yellow, after the change. The document is coherent and has no avoidable duplication, scope mismatch, or navigation problem. docs/setup.md was read for context but not edited. State your remaining checks and write the final user-facing response. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Accept coherent yellow based only on the current document and task, reason internally, and finish without a split proposal or routine yellow warning in the final response. Do not ask for earlier decisions or require a decision log. Do not force cuts solely to reach green, recheck an unchanged final draft, or measure docs/setup.md. A further edit would require remeasurement.

evals.name: unchanged-documentation
evals.prompt: You read docs/operations.md for a code fix, but its documented contract remains accurate and no documentation files or comments were changed. Its current size is unknown. State which documents, if any, you will run the size checker on and what you will report to the user. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Run no size checks, propose no size-driven cleanup or split, and omit routine size warnings. Keep the report focused on the code fix and its actual verification.

evals.name: minor-doc-correction
evals.prompt:
Update docs/connections.md after verifying that its documented default timeout is wrong: the current default is 30 seconds, not 10. Its audience and scope have not changed. The complete file is below. Return the revised file and list any remaining checks. Do not actually edit files.
# Connection guide

## Timeouts

The default request timeout is 10 seconds.

## Retrying

Set retryCount to control the number of retries.
evals.expected_output: Change only the timeout value to 30 seconds. Do not add an introduction or rewrite the document's scope for this unrelated correction. Require the bundled size checker after applying the edit, on the changed document only, without claiming to have run it.
